source: Playlist-specific adaptation of the FIGURES.md method, 21 September 2026: three user-supplied competitor keyword exports, direct inspection of all twelve Spotify playlist pages, publisher and curator identity checks, and comparison against RouteNote, Audiohype, British GQ, SoundCampaign and MidderMusic. The required objects are playlists, not individual records.
note: Each recommendation must be named and playable as the playlist itself. Compact official Spotify embeds are intentional: the page recommends curated lists and exposes a short sample without loading 36 separate track players.
